critical_code_review_comments: calc.js equityCurve anchors initial point at first-trade date rather than a truly pre-trade timestamp — visually acceptable but the 'Start' anchor and first trade share the same date value, causing a very short flat segment at the start. Consider anchoring at (firstTradeDate - 1 day) or account creation date for a cleaner curve.

Lightbox inner flex wrapper has both position:absolute inset:0 and the parent uses display:flex with alignItems/justifyContent center — the inner wrapper is redundant. Not a bug, minor cleanup opportunity.
Charts.jsx AreaChart Y-domain uses 8% margin which works well; no changes needed.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-existing demo data (10 trades, 2 accounts) — no new seeding needed. Trade NAS100 (2026-08-15) had 2 photos (portrait 600x1200 + wide 1600x500).
